acceptance: Every depicted face is visibly warm with relaxed non-converging brows, open eyes and an upturned smile.
Diverse adult silhouettes remain, with balanced shoulders, torso, limb thickness and leg length.
Every phase has exactly two connected arms and complete wrists/hands, with visible prop contact and no stray skin slivers.
Each row has four meaningful distinct phases with stable identity and stationary supporting props.
Flat shadow-free native ImageGen art and alpha are preserved; no pixel recoloring or code-painted anatomy.
